response.justification: Bogdan is a highly skilled engineer with 18+ years of experience, deep technical proficiency across all required programming languages, and a strong track record shipping production systems at scale. However, this Principal role is highly specialized around growth and experimentation systems—specifically designing experimentation frameworks, metrics infrastructure, rollout automation, and statistical analysis. The resume shows no demonstrated experience building experimentation platforms, feature-flagging systems, A/B testing infrastructure, or metrics-driven systems, which are core responsibilities. While his technical foundation is strong enough to potentially learn these domains, a Principal-level hire should already bring deep expertise in experimentation systems.
strengths: 18+ years of software engineering across web, mobile, desktop, and embedded systems with mastery of all required programming languages (JavaScript, TypeScript, C, C++, C#, Java)
Demonstrated ability to architect and maintain platforms used by multiple teams (GISCollective) and systems handling high-scale traffic (Dunnhumby's millions of requests/second microservices)
Strong technical leadership with experience mentoring others, organizing technical initiatives (refactoring dojos, workshops), and shipping systems across full-stack environments
concerns: No demonstrated experience building experimentation platforms, A/B testing frameworks, feature-flagging systems, or rollout management—core responsibilities of this Principal role
Resume lacks evidence of metrics infrastructure, telemetry systems, statistical analysis, or experimentation quality focus—all key required competencies for this specialization
Limited proof of designing multi-region globally distributed systems or high-availability features at enterprise scale, which is a preferred qualification for Principal-level infrastructure work
